protocol.dataset: Isolated synthetic orders/customers using seed_data.sql generation rules
protocol.query_family: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id <= upper_bound
protocol.selectivity: Actual returned rows divided by total orders; targets assume uniform customer IDs
protocol.phase_order: Baseline first in trials 1 and 3; indexed first in trial 2
protocol.measurement: Per-query client execute + fetchall medians, in milliseconds
protocol.summary: Median across trials; gain is the median of paired query percentages
protocol.diagnostics: Index usage and scan types from separate EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS runs
protocol.query_weights: Equal experimental weights; pooled scores are not the original workload score
protocol.optimizer: Planner chooses freely; no scan method is forced
protocol.scope: Read performance at four target match fractions; write costs excluded

protocol.cache_policy: warmup rounds; no forced cache clearing
protocol.frequency_usage: aggregation weights; equal repeats per query
